title: Wild Crisp Tunisian Oyster Mushroom Skewers
description: A salty and crisp Tunisian dish featuring oyster mushrooms, this recipe is perfect for special occasions, and is sugar free friendly.
instructions: Soak 10 bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, black pepper, and harissa.
Add the oyster mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 2-3 mushrooms onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each mushroom.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Immediately plunge the cooked skewers into an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the skewers cool to room temperature, then serve.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
